disclaimer: Demonstration prototype. All projects, risk scores and AI outputs on this platform are simulated showcase data and are not connected to live government systems.

problem_statement.title: Use case on web-based integrated project-monitoring platform
problem_statement.organization: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

data_sources.name: PAIMANA portal
data_sources.detail: Project Assessment, Infrastructure Monitoring and Analytics for Nation-building — the live monthly reporting portal that replaced OCMS.
data_sources.role: Monthly Common Upload Form submissions from implementing agencies

data_sources.name: OCMS archive
data_sources.detail: Online Computerised Monitoring System records, which carry the historical reason-for-delay labels the newer format no longer publishes.
data_sources.role: Supervised training labels for time and cost overrun

data_sources.name: Flash Report series
data_sources.detail: MoSPI's monthly report on central sector projects costing Rs 150 crore and above.

mospi_reasons.R2: Delay in obtaining forest / environment clearances
mospi_reasons.R3: Lack of infrastructure support and linkages
mospi_reasons.R4: Delay in tie-up of project financing
mospi_reasons.R5: Delay in finalization of detailed engineering / change in scope
mospi_reasons.R7: Delay in ordering and equipment supply
mospi_reasons.R10: Pre-commissioning teething troubles and contractual issues
mospi_reasons.UNC: Not captured in the Common Upload Form

data_gaps.why: Repeat slippage by the same contractor across projects is the single strongest leading indicator in the demo model.
data_gaps.source_hint: Derivable from CPPP tender history joined on contractor PAN

data_gaps.why: Weather accounts for up to 20% of attributed slippage on hill and coastal packages but has no CUF field.
data_gaps.source_hint: IMD district rainfall series, joined on project district

data_gaps.why: Cumulative physical progress hides which activity is actually stalled, so root-cause attribution stays coarse.
data_gaps.source_hint: Extend the Common Upload Form with milestone rows

data_gaps.why: Running-account bills pending beyond 60 days precede contractor demobilisation by roughly one quarter.

data_gaps.variable: Commodity price index at package level
data_gaps.why: Steel and cement movement explains a large share of cost revision that the current fields cannot separate from scope change.
data_gaps.source_hint: Office of the Economic Adviser WPI series

model_card.disclaimer: Illustrative prototype figures. No model is trained in this demo; these values describe the intended evaluation design.
model_card.target: Time overrun of more than 30 days against the sanctioned completion date
model_card.validation: Rolling-origin split on archived monthly reports, 3 folds

models.name: Logistic regression (baseline)
models.note: Interpretable, cheap to retrain, the benchmark every claim is measured against.

models.name: Gradient-boosted trees
models.note: Captures interaction between clearance status and contractor load that the linear baseline misses.

models.name: Survival model (time-to-milestone)
models.note: Predicts when slippage occurs, not only whether, which is what an early-warning desk needs.
